channel.title: Trails RG Studio
channel.description: macOS updates for Trails RG Studio (Sparkle)

item.title: Version 1.0.0-beta.2 (66)
item.description:
See the subject, and choose the folders

  • Trail scenes shows the subject when one is found, and says when a frame has none
  • Find sharpest shows the frame, the box, and the crop as each photo is scored
  • Check the folders to scan. A waiting mark stays until that folder is done
